scripts.hasura:metadata:apply: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; hasura metadata apply --project hasura --admin-secret "$HASURA_GRAPHQL_ADMIN_SECRET"'
scripts.hasura:migrate:apply: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; hasura migrate apply --database-name default --project hasura --admin-secret "$HASURA_GRAPHQL_ADMIN_SECRET"'
